svg.text: FREE EDGE of the flat leg: trim on the heavy line, set it flush with the leg's free edge
J5: TRIM HERE, lay this edge on sheet 5's J5 line
J6: sheet 7 butts here (tab under it)
screw line 19 mm from the free edge
CALIBRATION 0-100 mm: must measure 100.0 (+/- 0.5)
50 mm CROSS-CHECK
DRILL ⌀5.56 (7/32 in) through the
steel; 1/8 in pilot first (dashed).
Centre-punch through the paper, low
speed, cutting oil.
Ticks and numbers: position only, never
drilled.
Preferred method: the printed rail drill jig
on the 19 line, with a tape from the
reference end. This strip is the check. Tape
it to either face of the flat leg. 19 is from
the FREE edge (chapter E), not from the heel.
MEASURE THE DELIVERED RAIL
Design 213.0 cm (2130 mm); bought as 84
in = 213.4 cm (2133.6 mm). Every
station runs from the labelled wall
end; the far end carries any extra.
Tape-check each station from that end.
Joins: trim each later sheet on its start J line and lay it on the previous sheet's J line so ticks, numbers and the screw line run on; tape. Rail A
